name: What is the process for a custom kitchen remodel with Simply Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a custom kitchen remodel with Simply Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, needs, and budget. This is followed by design development, where we create detailed plans and select materials. Once designs are finalized and approved, we handle all necessary permits. The construction phase involves demolition, structural work (if needed), plumbing and electrical rough-ins, cabinet installation, countertop fabrication, appliance installation, and final finishing touches. We maintain clear communication throughout every stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our remodel process involves consultation, design, permit acquisition, demolition, construction (plumbing, electrical, cabinetry), and final finishing. We ensure clear communication throughout.
